items.html:
A right-hand batsman and medium-pace bowler, Deunte Darrell took to cricket at the age of ten. He went on to represent Bermuda at the Under-15 and Under-19 levels and is part of their squad for the U-19 World Cup in 2008. Darrell's favourite cricketer is Sachin Tendulkar and he is also interested in carpentry.
Cricinfo staff February 2008
